subject: ArborTech security ops roundtable — scheduling and pre-read coordination
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@arbortech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: ArborTech security ops roundtable — proposed slots + attendees

Ellen — thanks again for taking the call earlier. Following up to lock in a focused security ops readout (deep-dive) so our Security and Solutions teams can walk through controls, infra, and the evidence artifacts you requested. High-level ask: 60–90 minutes with space for Q&A and a short demo of how we handle KV caching, tenant isolation, and audit logs.

Proposed 90-minute slots (PST):
- Tue 1 Jun, 11:00–12:30
- Wed 2 Jun, 09:00–10:30
- Thu 3 Jun, 14:00–15:30

Planned Redwood attendees:
- Rishi Malhotra — Security Lead (policy, SOC2 evidence)
- Grace O'Connor — Solutions Engineer (runtime and network walk-through)
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success (onboarding & runbook)
- Myself (AE) — agenda + procurement coordination

Would you please confirm who from ArborTech should attend (SRE, security manager, procurement)? Also attaching our one-pager pre-read and the security questionnaire so you can flag anything to prioritize. If none of the above slots work, send a couple of windows and we'll re-iterate.

Attachments: Redwood_PreRead_Summary.pdf; Redwood_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks — Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0162

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@arbortech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rahul Sen <rahul.sen@arbortech.com>, procurement@arbortech.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArborTech security ops roundtable — proposed slots + attendees

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear options. A couple of notes:
- Our security leadership is out 1–2 Jun. Can we aim for Thu 3 Jun or Mon 7 Jun?
- I'll want Rahul (SRE) and our procurement contact on the invite; I added procurement@arbortech.com to this reply.
- Please include your compliance/security lead — we usually track controls against our internal risk checklist.

Also: we have a standing 45-minute gate for procurement calls; if the technical portion needs 90 minutes, let's split: 45 minutes for SRE + demo, followed by a 30–45 minute controls deep-dive with security folks. Does that work?

Ellen
Ellen Park
Security Engineer, ArborTech
ellen.park@arbortech.com | +1 (212) 555-0244

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@arbortech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArborTech security ops roundtable — proposed slots + attendees

Thanks Ellen — Rishi here from Redwood Security. Thu 3 Jun works for me. I agree with splitting the session into two adjacent blocks so we can keep procurement on the shorter gate and still leave time for a deep controls review. Proposed structure:

- Block A (45m): SRE + Solutions — demo of runtime isolation, network flows, and operational runbooks (Grace + Marissa lead)
- 15m break / buffer (optional)
- Block B (45m): Security deep-dive — compliance artifacts, SOC2 evidence paths, data retention, key management, and incident response (I will lead)

Pre-reads we'd like to receive 48 hours in advance: ArborTech network diagram (redact IPs okay), list of compliance controls you want validated, any specific threat scenarios. We'll attach a short checklist and internal SOC2 mapping for context.

Attachments: ArborTech_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (you already have), network-arch.png (sample diagram we referenced)

I'll be on the call and will bring our internal runbook snippets. Looking forward to it.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Lead, Product Security, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@arbortech.com>, Rahul Sen <rahul.sen@arbortech.com>, procurement@arbortech.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArborTech security ops roundtable — confirmed Thu 3 Jun + invite

Great — thanks all for the quick sync. Thu 3 Jun is confirmed in the calendar: 14:00–15:30 PST (90m total split into 45m + 45m with a 15m buffer). I sent a calendar invite (link below) to everyone listed; please accept so we can finalize attendee list.

I've uploaded the pre-read folder and a short mutual action plan to the shared drive. Key links and one-pagers attached to this email for quick visibility. If procurement prefers a separate 30-minute commercial-only call, happy to schedule that directly after the technical session.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=arbortech-roundtable-20270601
Pre-read: https://drive.google.com/open?id=arbortech-preread-2027
Attachments: Redwood_PreRead_Summary.pdf; ArborTech_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx; network-arch.png

Action items before Thu:
- Ellen / Rahul: please drop a redacted network diagram (or confirm we can use the sample) by Tue EOD (1 Jun).
- Procurement: share PO process or preferred contract rep (procurement@arbortech.com).
- Redwood: Rishi will prepare SOC2 mapping; Grace will prepare demo scope and runbook snippets.

If anyone needs the time shifted later in the week, flag it by EOD today and we'll re-run availability.

Thanks — Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@arbortech.com>

Thanks Karthik — invite accepted. Rahul will be there for the SRE portion; I'll stay for the deep-dive. Procurement looped in (they might send a representative if contracting questions arise).

Uploading a redacted topology now to the drive link. See you Thu.

Ellen
